module Main where
import Control.Monad (forM_)
import Infera hiding (main, solveQuery)
import qualified Infera.Core.Run as Run
import Infera.Core.Store (initialCollectLimit)
import qualified Infera.Engine.Reference as Reference

drain :: IO Run.Step -> IO Search
drain action = do
  step <- action
  case step of
    Run.Stop -> pure []
    Run.Yield item next -> (item :) <$> drain next
    Run.Abandon reason -> fail reason

main :: IO ()
main = do
  loaded <- loadFile "bench/bench.nprolog"
  (program, _) <- either fail pure loaded
  forM_ ["once (loop 90000, Result = 90000)?",
    "once (bench_nrev 100, range 1 30 L, nrev L Result)?"] $ \text -> do
    query <- either fail pure (parseQuery text)
    (reason, first, counters) <- Run.runCoreWithSlotStats initialCollectLimit program query
    case reason of
      Nothing -> pure ()
      Just unsupported -> fail unsupported
    items <- drain first
    evidence <- counters
    print (text, evidence, map (Reference.showAnswer . Reference.projectAnswer query)
      [state | Found state <- items], summarizeSearch query items)
